nodes.description: Ownable._owner: current owner address used in onlyOwner checks
Ownable._previousOwner: address stored when the contract is locked, used by unlock()
Ownable._lockTime: block.timestamp based unlock deadline stored in lock()
Reflection balance mapping _rOwned[address] => uint256
Token balance mapping _tOwned[address] => uint256 for excluded accounts
ERC20 allowance mapping _allowances[owner][spender] => uint256
_whiteList mapping of fee-exempt / whitelisted addresses
_isExcluded mapping flagging accounts excluded from reflection rewards
_tTotal: total token supply constant 1000000000000 * 10**9
_rTotal: total reflection supply (MAX - MAX % _tTotal), mutated by _reflectFee and deliver
_tFeeTotal: accumulated fee tokens, mutated by _reflectFee and deliver
_taxFee: current reflection tax percent applied per transfer
_marketingFee: current marketing fee percent, read by swapAndLiquify and takeMarketing
_liquidityFee: current liquidity fee percent, read by swapAndLiquify
_burnFee: current burn fee percent read by takeBurn
_buyTaxFee: buy-side reflection tax set by owner
_buyMarketingFee: buy-side marketing fee set by owner
_buyLiquidityFee: buy-side liquidity fee set by owner
_buyBurnFee: buy-side burn fee set by owner
_sellTaxFee: sell-side reflection tax set by owner
_sellMarketingFee: sell-side marketing fee set by owner
_sellLiquidityFee: sell-side liquidity fee set by owner
_sellBurnFee: sell-side burn fee set by owner
marketingWallet: payable address receiving marketing ETH via transferToAddressETH
uniswapV2Router: router used for swaps and liquidity, changeable by owner
uniswapV2Pair: the token/WETH pair address used for buy/sell detection
inSwapAndLiquify reentrancy lock flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier
swapAndLiquifyEnabled: toggles automatic liquidity/marketing swap during transfers
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity: threshold of contract tokens that triggers swapAndLiquify
_maxTxAmount: maximum transfer size enforced in _tokenTransfer
maxBuyTransactionAmount: max buy size enforced in _transfer for pair buys
maxWalletToken: maximum balance a wallet can hold, enforced in _transfer
deadAddress: 0x...dEaD burn sink credited by takeBurn
ERC20 transfer(recipient, amount) entry point delegating to _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) delegating to _transfer and _approve
ERC20 approve(spender, amount) delegating to _approve
_transfer: core transfer logic with wallet cap, buy cap, auto swapAndLiquify trigger, fee selection and _tokenTransfer call
swapAndLiquify: splits contract tokens, swaps for ETH, adds liquidity and pays marketing, guarded by lockTheSwap
_tokenTransfer: applies whitelist/maxTxAmount checks and dispatches to excluded/non-excluded transfer variants
_transferStandard: standard reflection transfer path with burn/marketing deductions
_transferToExcluded: transfer path where recipient is excluded from rewards
_transferFromExcluded: transfer path where sender is excluded from rewards
takeBurn: computes burn amount from _burnFee and credits deadAddress
takeMarketing: computes marketing amount from _marketingFee and credits the contract balance
swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps tokens for ETH using the router
addLiquidity: approves router and adds ETH/token liquidity to Uniswap
transferToAddressETH: sends ETH to a payable recipient using transfer
Ownable.lock(time): owner-only locking of ownership using block.timestamp
Ownable.unlock: restores previous owner if msg.sender matches and lock time expired
setMarketingWallet: owner-only update of the marketing payout address
setRouterAddress: owner-only replacement of router and creation of a new pair
setBuyFeePercent: owner-only update of buy-side fee parameters
setSellFeePercent: owner-only update of sell-side fee parameters
excludeFromFee: owner-only whitelisting of an account (fee exemption)
includeInFee: owner-only removal of an account from the whitelist
setMaxTxAmount: owner-only update of _maxTxAmount
setMaxBuytx: owner-only update of maxBuyTransactionAmount
setMaxWalletToken: owner-only update of maxWalletToken
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as sender/owner checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used in lock/unlock and swap deadlines
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with block.timestamp deadline
external payable call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH forwarding contract ETH
recipient.transfer(amount): native ETH send to marketingWallet
external call IUniswapV2Factory(...).createPair during setRouterAddress
division by combineFees (_liquidityFee + _marketingFee) in swapAndLiquify can divide by zero
tAmount.div(100).mul(_burnFee/_marketingFee) fee arithmetic in takeBurn/takeMarketing
parameter from of _transfer
parameter to of _transfer
parameter amount of _transfer
parameter contractTokenBalance of swapAndLiquify
parameter time of lock used to compute _lockTime
parameter newRouter of setRouterAddress
parameter recipient of transferToAddressETH
parameter amount of transferToAddressETH
local combineFees = _liquidityFee.add(_marketingFee) used as divisor
local tokensForLiquidity computed from contractTokenBalance and fees
local half of liquidity tokens swapped to ETH
local takeFee flag set from whitelist status in _transfer/_tokenTransfer

takeMarketing credits _rOwned of the contract

parameter from feeds the zero-address and pair checks in _transfer
parameter to feeds wallet-cap and fee-branch checks in _transfer
parameter amount feeds the max buy and max tx checks in _transfer
parameter contractTokenBalance determines the token split in swapAndLiquify
parameter time is added to block.timestamp to set _lockTime
parameter newRouter becomes the new uniswapV2Router and pair factory source
parameter recipient is the ETH transfer destination
parameter amount is the ETH value sent via transfer
local combineFees is the divisor used by the unsafe division
local tokensForLiquidity drives the swap and liquidity amounts
local half of the liquidity tokens is passed to swapTokensForEth
local takeFee flag is derived from whitelist status for the fee branch

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only has meaning inside _transfer, so it folds into the _transfer core function node.
The to parameter is consumed only by _transfer checks and fee branching, so it merges into _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated and forwarded only by _transfer, so it merges into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is the sole input of swapAndLiquify and merges into that core function.
The time parameter is used only to compute _lockTime inside lock, so it merges into lock.
newRouter exists only to rewrite the router and pair inside setRouterAddress, so it merges into that function.
recipient is the destination of the ETH send and merges into transferToAddressETH.
amount is the value of the ETH send and merges into transferToAddressETH.
combineFees is the divisor that can be zero, so it merges into the unsafe division operation node.
tokensForLiquidity is an intermediate split value used only inside swapAndLiquify.
half is passed directly as the tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth, so it merges there.
takeFee is a transient whitelist-derived flag consumed by _tokenTransfer/_transfer, so it merges into _tokenTransfer.
